purpose: Preflight of the adaptive-source batch: hashes, server-side OT costs, support statistics, unit tests a-d, smoke of every group on the 7 tasks, throughput of 6 OTDF processes per GPU, normalization table.
support_definition: Distances are Euclidean in the space standardised by the per-dimension mean and standard deviation (floor 1e-3) of the target training arrays (official call_tar_dataset rows). tau = 0.9 quantile of the target (s, a) leave-one-trajectory-out nearest-neighbour distances (all points of the own trajectory excluded); tau_state: the same with states only. D_ret(rho) = first floor(rho * N) source rows sorted by the stored OT value, largest first (stable); D_near(rho) = rows of D_ret(rho) with (s, a) distance <= tau; rho80R = |D_near(0.8)| rows drawn without replacement from D_ret(0.8) with a fixed per-task seed.
